solutions.title: Forward scan
solutions.strategy: For each position, scan right until a warmer value is found or the array ends.

timeComplexity.explanation: In the worst case each day scans nearly every later day.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the output array and loop counters are used.

solutions.title: Monotonic stack
solutions.strategy: Keep indices with unresolved warmer days in decreasing temperature order and resolve them when a warmer day arrives.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each index is pushed once and popped at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The stack can hold all indices when temperatures never rise.
